svg.title: TaskFlow backend architecture and API flow
svg.text: Express 5 + TypeScript REST API · Prisma ORM · PostgreSQL · JWT in httpOnly cookie · email via SMTP
Every API call passes through the same pipeline, left to right. Any step can stop it with an error.
AppError → its status · ZodError → 400 with field errors · anything else → logged, 500 "Something went wrong"
JSON { data } or { error: { message, details } }
Method · path · what it does → tables it touches. Badge on the right = who may call it (checked on the server).
bcrypt hash, set JWT cookie (+ join project if inviteToken) → users
check bcrypt hash, set httpOnly JWT cookie (1 day) → users
who am I (frontend calls this on load) → users
look up sha256(token): project, inviter, status → project_invitations
email must match; join + mark used (1 transaction)
1 aggregate SQL for counts + attention top 4 + mentions top 4
SELECT 1: used by Docker / load balancer health checks
my projects + my role + progress (1 groupBy, no N+1)
create; creator becomes OWNER → projects, project_members
one project with my role and progress
team list, owner first → project_members, users
remove (or leave); unassign their tasks (1 txn)
random token, store sha256, expires 24h, email
create; members' tasks are auto-assigned to themselves
update + history row in 1 transaction → tasks, task_activities
save comment + mentioned ids; email each tagged person
PK = primary key · FK = foreign key · ◆ = index. Arrows point from the "many" side to the "one" side.

What keeps the API fast as data and traffic grow, and where it is in the code.
One WHERE built as an AND list: visibility rule +
status + priority + assignee + due + title ILIKE '%q%'
Frontend debounces typing (300 ms): 1 request, not 1/key
Next step at scale: pg_trgm GIN index on tasks.title
Response: { data, meta: { page, limit, total, totalPages } }
Next step: cursor pagination for very deep pages
GIN index = per-user list of comments that contain them
Used by dashboard "Mentioned you" + tagged-task access
No N+1 queries; cost doesn't grow with project count
Session lives in the JWT cookie, not in server memory
Run N API containers behind a load balancer
GET /api/health checks the DB for LB / Docker probes
Next steps: Redis cache for stats, PgBouncer pooling
Task update + its history row: both or neither
Remove member + unassign their tasks: one transaction
Accept invite: add member + mark link used together
Project delete: DB cascades, not N application deletes
Dashboard lists capped at 4 ("View all" pages them)
Mention emails sent after save, never block the reply
Failed invite email: invite still saved, "Resend"
Security that holds at any scale
bcrypt passwords · httpOnly SameSite JWT cookie
Invite links: only sha256(token) stored, 24h, one use
Every query filtered by projectAccess rules (404 / 403)
helmet headers · CORS allowlist · Zod on every input
